changelog: D&D 5e comes to FORGEFALL: 14 creature types with real enforced immunities/resistances (constructs ignore poison, fiends resist fire/cold/lightning), ability scores on every enemy, 12 playable classes swappable mid-match via Forge prompt ('make me a rogue') or the new CLASS tab, 10 elemental emitters (fire/cold/lightning/acid/poison/radiant/necrotic/thunder/force/water) from Forge structures, elemental turrets/weapons, and mods — with real interactions (water extinguishes burn, lightning chains off wet targets) — plus 8 spell-school tags for spell-like mods. DOT ticks are now typed damage (burn=fire, poison=poison, bleed=slashing) so creature resistances apply to them too.
